name: UK Butcher Meat Price Comparison Site

mentions.name: UK Butcher Meat Price Comparison Site
mentions.description: A comparison site that scrapes meat prices from UK butchers across multiple platforms and uses a taxonomy matcher to enable comparisons between differently named products (e.g., “apples” vs “meaty apples”). Built as a side project, currently UK-only, and scalable to other countries if there is demand.
mentions.problem: Struggled to find the best priced meat from UK butchers and keep the data up-to-date in a spreadsheet.
mentions.audience: Struggled to find the best priced meat from UK butchers keeping up-to-date in my spreadsheet so built a comparison site with multi platform scraper (and a taxonomy matcher to allow “apples” to “meaty apples” comparisons).
